Brother, I traced Maadi’s October 28 call at 1:21 PM Chicago time in both GHL and Zoom. It reached Zoom’s menu, recorded “No user response” and ended after 19 seconds. It never entered a staff queue, so Tracy’s DND wasn’t the stage where this call stopped. The log doesn’t confirm who ended the call. The main New Client queue has the correct order: Tracy → Kassem → Sharif → Carmen → Jenna. All five have queue calls enabled. I found two separate gaps in Zoom: callers who make no menu selection are disconnected after three prompts, and Carmen is missing from the backup overflow queue. That backup also has only a 30-second total limit for four people ringing 15 seconds each. My proposed fix is to send callers who make no selection to the New Client queue, add Carmen to the backup sequence and allow enough time for everyone to ring. Then we should verify the menu, no-selection and unanswered/…

Regarding this caller, [mention] was able to login to Zoom (for some reason it doesn't allow me to) in order to check. We see that the Zoom option to forward callers if they do not select an option in the IVR is not enabled. So no forwarding happens if no option is chosen. This was untouched by us and was a preset to be off so we will enable the working forwarding after no IVR option is chosen.
